description.zh: 文字、链接或剪贴板内容生成二维码：Enter 复制图片，Ctrl+Enter 预览，Shift+Enter 存 PNG；qrwifi 直接列出连接过的 Wi-Fi 生成扫码即连的二维码
description.en: Turn text, a link or the clipboard into a QR code: Enter copies the image, Ctrl+Enter previews, Shift+Enter saves a PNG; qrwifi lists the Wi-Fi networks you have joined and builds a scan-to-join code

hint.zh: 输入文字或链接；留空用剪贴板
hint.en: text or a link; empty uses the clipboard

ai.description: Generate a QR code image from the query text, or from the clipboard text when the query is empty. The result reports the content type (URL / text / Wi-Fi), QR version, ECC level and encoded byte count. Read-only: nothing changes until an action runs.

hint.zh: 留空列出连接过的 Wi-Fi；输入可筛选，或直接写 SSID 密码
hint.en: empty lists joined networks; type to filter, or write SSID password

ai.description: Generate a scan-to-join Wi-Fi QR code. With no text, list the networks this machine has joined (their saved profiles, passphrase included); typing filters that list, and text that matches no saved network is read as "SSID password" (empty password = open network). Networks Windows cannot share (802.1X, an unreadable key) are listed as unavailable. The password is not stored anywhere; only the image is produced.

hint.zh: 每个黑白格的边长，2–20，默认 8
hint.en: Edge length of each module, 2–20, default 8

hint.zh: 四周留白为几个模块宽，0–8，默认 4
